annotations.description: Casting Wildwood Scourge for X=1 creates a 1/1, while Ironshell Beetle would create a 2/2 (1/1 + its own ETB counter). The Scourge is better played later when it can benefit from future +1/+1 counter placements from Ironshell Beetle and Fertilid. Playing the Beetle first gives a bigger body now and preserves the Scourge for better value later at a higher X.
annotations.actionTaken: Cast Wildwood Scourge for X=1 as a 1/1
annotations.betterLine: Cast Ironshell Beetle, targeting itself with its ETB trigger to make a 2/2, and save Wildwood Scourge for a later turn when it can be cast at higher X and benefit from counter synergies

annotations.description: Opponent has no untapped creatures (Wildwood Scourge is tapped, Fertilid is sick) and no untapped mana for tricks. Attacking with the 1/1 Mild-Mannered Librarian is completely free damage with zero risk.
annotations.betterLine: Attack with Mild-Mannered Librarian for 1 free damage. The 1/1 can't meaningfully block the opponent's 2/2 creatures anyway, so there's no defensive value in holding it back.

annotations.description: Opponent has only one untapped blocker (Mild-Mannered Librarian 1/1) with all lands tapped (no combat tricks possible). Attacking with only Wildwood Scourge wastes the opportunity to push 3-4 additional damage with Fertilid and Burglar Rat, since at most one can be blocked.
annotations.betterLine: Attack with Wildwood Scourge, Fertilid, and Burglar Rat. Opponent can only block one creature with the 1/1 Librarian, so at least 7 damage gets through instead of 4, with no real risk since opponent's lands are all tapped.

annotations.description: Declined to chump block a 4/4 Wildwood Scourge with the 0/1 Ferocious Pup body. The Pup's 0/1 body is nearly worthless for future combat, so trading it to prevent 4 damage (going to 12 instead of 16) would have been free value. At 16 life it's not critical, but the 0/1 body has essentially no future utility.
annotations.actionTaken: No blocks, taking 4 damage from Wildwood Scourge
annotations.betterLine: Chump block with Ferocious Pup 0/1 to save 4 life at no meaningful cost

annotations.description: GPT53C Humble passed in postcombat main with exactly {1}{G} available and Fertilid's ramp ability as the only legal action. Activating Fertilid to fetch a basic land is pure upside — it thins the deck, ramps for future turns, and the mana would otherwise go unused. The player had no other use for the mana this turn.
annotations.actionTaken: Passed priority, ending the turn with 3 untapped lands and Fertilid's ability unused.
annotations.betterLine: Activate Fertilid ({1}{G}, remove a +1/+1 counter) to search for a basic land (likely a Swamp to ensure Eviscerate mana next turn). This costs nothing meaningful — Fertilid goes from 3/3 to 2/2 and the mana was going to waste anyway.

annotations.description: Cast Chains of Custody before playing a land drop. While the player has exactly enough mana to cast Chains (Forest, Forest, Plains), playing the Plains first would leave an additional mana open after casting Chains. Playing lands before spells is a fundamental sequencing principle - it costs nothing and preserves optionality.
annotations.actionTaken: Cast Chains of Custody before playing Plains
annotations.betterLine: Play Plains first, then cast Chains of Custody, leaving 1 extra mana open after the spell resolves

annotations.description: Chains of Custody was placed on Ferocious Pup (0/1), the most fragile creature on the board. If the Pup dies in combat or to any incidental damage, the exiled permanent returns. The Ward {2} is also wasted on a 0/1 with no special abilities.
annotations.actionTaken: Enchanted Ferocious Pup (0/1) with Chains of Custody
annotations.betterLine: Enchant the Wolf Token (2/2) with Chains of Custody — it's the most durable creature and hardest to remove in combat, making the exile most likely to stick. Alternatively, enchant Mild-Mannered Librarian to protect its valuable activated ability with Ward {2}.

annotations.description: Blocked a 2/2 Wolf Token with Burglar Rat 1/1 instead of Fertilid 3/3. Burglar Rat dies without killing the Wolf (just prevents 1 damage since the rat only has 1 power assigned back). Fertilid 3/3 could have blocked and killed the Wolf Token while surviving at 3/1. Opponent's lands were all tapped so no combat tricks were possible.
annotations.actionTaken: Blocked Wolf Token 2/2 with Burglar Rat 1/1, losing the Rat while the Wolf survives
annotations.betterLine: Block with Fertilid 3/3, which kills the Wolf Token and survives the combat, cleanly removing an attacker at no cost

annotations.description: Eviscerate was used on Ferocious Pup (a 0/1 creature) instead of the Wolf Token (2/2) or Mild-Mannered Librarian (which can transform into a significant threat). Ferocious Pup is the least threatening creature on the opponent's board. Additionally, the Wildwood Scourge is exiled under Chains of Custody enchanting one of the opponent's creatures — killing the enchanted creature would free the Scourge, but Ferocious Pup is not the enchanted creature (Chains of Custody enchants a creature the opponent controls). The Wolf Token is a 2/2 actual threat, and the Mild-Mannered Librarian can activate to become a 3/3 with card draw. Spending a premium removal spell on a 0/1 is a significant waste of resources.
annotations.betterLine: Cast Eviscerate targeting Mild-Mannered Librarian (to prevent it from transforming into a 3/3 and drawing a card) or the Wolf Token (2/2) to remove actual board presence.

annotations.description: Missed lethal. With opponent at 7 life and both opponent creatures tapped, GPT53C could attack with Crypt Rats (1/1) and Ironshell Beetle (1/1) for 2 unblocked damage (opponent to 5), then in postcombat main activate Crypt Rats for X=5 (using 5 Swamps) dealing 5 damage to each player — opponent goes from 5 to 0 (dead), GPT53C goes from 10 to 5 (alive).
annotations.actionTaken: Passed priority in precombat main phase, effectively ending the turn without casting spells or attacking.
annotations.betterLine: Move to combat, attack with Crypt Rats and Ironshell Beetle (both unblocked since opponent's creatures are tapped), deal 2 damage putting opponent to 5, then activate Crypt Rats for X=5 in postcombat main to deal 5 to each player for lethal.
